summary.description: Fluoranthene is a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH), appearing as a yellow to green solid, practically insoluble in water. It is used in the production of fluorescent dyes, pharmaceuticals, and agrochemicals.
emission_sources: Incomplete combustion of wood, coal, oil, propane, gasoline, and diesel
environmental_impact: Carcinogenic to humans as part of PAHs
Potential to accumulate in soil and sediments, affecting terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Fluoranthene is carcinogenic and exposure through air pollution poses serious long-term health risks to humans.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG11_Sustainable_Cities_and_Communities: Fluoranthene is a common pollutant in urban areas due to vehicle emissions and residential combustion, threatening air quality and urban health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: The release of fluoranthene from industrial and combustion processes highlights the need for safer, cleaner production and waste management practices.
